intelligence.human_view: A reference page is not a mood board — it is the floor. "Don't make a page that's less quality" means the Hub, Life with Naya, the Personal page, and nayanet.app are the minimum a new page has to clear, and the day view has to clear them by being one of the most extraordinary pages of all — because it is the first thing a person sees in their day. And "the king's daily report" tells you what extraordinary means here: it is not decoration, it is a welcome — your name, a wisdom quote, your whole day, unfolding section by section, mechanical and alive. If the page does not feel like that, it is text in a box, and he has already told us what that is: a fumbled ball.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine the king wakes up and someone hands him his whole day — beautifully, like a treasure unfolding, one wonderful part after another. That is what the day page should feel like. Not a list in a box. A royal report, made just for you, every morning.
intelligence.grandma_view: Dear, when he wakes up, dear, his day should open like a beautiful present, dear — his name, a wise little saying, his whole day unfolding, dear, one lovely part after another, dear. Not words in a box, dear — something extraordinary, dear, like a report made for a king, dear.
intelligence.naya_view: THE KING'S DAILY REPORT. EVERY PAGE AT THE QUALITY OF THE ICON. NEVER LESS THAN THE REFERENCE PAGES.
